title: Sharks Are Older Than Trees
description:
Sharks were swimming the oceans long before the first trees grew on land. Plus three more shark facts.

#shorts #animalfacts #shark #ocean

scenes.text: The first sharks appeared around four hundred and fifty million years ago. Trees came tens of millions of years later.
Many sharks have to keep swimming to breathe, pushing water over their gills as they move.
A shark can lose thousands of teeth in its lifetime, because new ones keep growing in rows behind the old ones.
And some sharks can sense the tiny electric signals given off by other animals' muscles.
Would you swim with sharks? Tell me in the comments.
